bull.b: A 3.6 billion daily user base creates durable network effects and unmatched ad reach across Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger. Scale strengthens targeting data, raises advertiser switching costs, and sustains long-term monetization potential across formats and regions.

Very high TTM margins reflect the low incremental cost of serving ads and platform-driven software economics. Structural profitability supports sustained reinvestment in AI and products while providing a durable cushion versus cyclical ad demand and enabling long-term return generation.

Robust operating cash flow and high cash conversion indicate strong earnings quality and provide a durable funding source for large-scale capex, debt servicing, strategic investments and acquisitions, underpinning the company's ability to scale AI and product initiatives.

bear.t: Very high and rising capital intensity
bear.b: Massive and sustained capex guidance to build AI compute and data centers materially increases capital deployment and extends payback periods. This structural intensity will pressure free cash flow, limit near-term distribution flexibility, and raise execution and supply-chain risk over multiple years.

A material increase in absolute debt over time raises leverage and future interest expense exposure. Although equity has grown, the upward debt trend reduces financial flexibility for opportunistic investments and increases sensitivity to funding costs and macro shocks over the medium term.

Significant legal charges and active regulatory matters create recurring downside risk through fines, remediation costs and product constraints. These structural compliance and litigation burdens can force costly changes to monetization, data practices and user engagement over multiple years.
